## What's new in Astronomical 0.2.90
- **`astronomical image`** draws one image from a prompt on your Mac, through the local daemon: `astronomical image "a lighthouse at dusk" --size 1024x576 --output lighthouse.png`. It also accepts `--seed` for reproducible results and `--model` to pick a model. It defaults to FLUX.2 Klein; Qwen-Image remains available with `--model Qwen-Image-2.1-MLX-4bit`. An existing file is never overwritten, and nothing is left behind if the image fails. - **Model downloads are easier to follow.** A download now shows percent, sizes, transfer rate and time remaining, and announces the total size before it starts. The wait ends only when a download stops making progress, so a large model on a slow connection is no longer cut off after two minutes. - **Model downloads resume.** Running a command for a model that is already downloading attaches to that download, an interrupted or paused download continues from the bytes already on disk, and restarting the app in the middle of a download no longer aborts the command that is waiting for it. - **Safer packaging.** The app bundle check now refuses hidden files and directories inside the bundle.
## Compatibility
Your settings, installed models and conversations are preserved. The command-line tool and the app's daemon ship together in this release.
## Distribution
Signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled. The in-app updater verifies the update with an Ed25519 signature before installing.
